entities.title: Define how EDTF qualifiers map to the uncertain kind
entities.summary: EDTF qualifiers (1347~, 1347?, 134X) need a mapping to UTV's uncertain kind before the text form can accept them; until then parsing them gives unsupported (unsupported-form).
entities.details: Approximate isn't the same as bounded, so the mapping needs its own definition. The review that proposed the text form (R5) listed 1347~ among the forms it should read; text-form.md deferred it.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/text-form.md defines the mapping of each EDTF qualifier to an uncertain value, and conformance/operations/text-form.json has fixtures for it.
Every library's parseText accepts the qualifiers and formatText writes them.

origin.description: Status note: "Deferred: EDTF qualifiers (1347~) need a mapping to the uncertain kind"; also docs/text-form.md, Not (yet) in the text form.

entities.title: Fixture counts in library-api.md §8 are out of date
entities.summary: §8 asks every library to pass all 130 everyday fixtures and the 44 text-form entries; the files hold 131 and 46.
entities.expected: The counts in docs/library-api.md §8 match conformance/operations/everyday.json and conformance/operations/text-form.json, or the text names the files without counts.
entities.observed: "all 130 everyday fixtures" and "(44 entries)", while everyday.json has 131 fixtures and text-form.json 46 (tools/validate.py prints both counts).
reproduction: Compare the counts it prints under Everyday API fixtures and Text-form fixtures with docs/library-api.md §8.
acceptanceCriteria: §8 no longer states a count that differs from the files.

origin.description: Found while documenting the conformance material: check_everyday_fixtures and check_text_form_fixtures print 131 and 46.
